question.text: Sahyadri Stat-Arb Fund (Cat III) breached its permitted leverage limit on a Monday due to an overnight FX move. The custodian's reporting obligation to SEBI is to report:

answer.text: Within 30 days along with the quarterly NAV report.
Before 10 a.m. on the next working day, providing the fund name, extent of breach and reasons.
Only if the breach lasts more than 5 consecutive trading days.
Annually, as part of the PPM audit.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 242 (also restated on page 410), where a Category III AIF breaches its permitted leverage limits, the custodian shall report to SEBI providing the name of the fund, the extent of the breach and the reasons for the same, before 10 a.m. on the next working day. The Trap: Option A under-reports — the obligation is next-working-day morning, not 30 days. Option C invents a multi-day grace period. Option D conflates the leverage-breach reporting with the annual audit cycle. Note: Anchor the answer on the custodian-reports-to-SEBI rule with the three required items (fund name, extent, reasons) and the before-10:00-AM next-working-day deadline.
